records.title: Complete Cyclic Subtask Graphs for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Flexibility, Cost, and Bottlenecks in Long-Horizon Workflows
records.reason: Complete cyclic subtask graphs are tested for tool-using LLM agents across ALFWorld, Finance-Agent and TextCraft with token/tool-call cost and revisitation analyses. Cyclic control can aid recovery but is mixed or less efficient elsewhere and can thrash. Limitations: compute proxies rather than wall-clock latency, narrow case-study benchmarks. Workflow cost is adjacent to, not a direct model-inference optimization.
